prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: anime category cover for a trivia game. Edit target: the attached local cover image. It must read unmistakably as Japanese anime even at thumbnail size: expressive oversized eyes with highlights, clean angular black ink lines, lively spiky dark hair, a friendly confident expression, and a simple purple jacket with flat cel-shaded accents. The drawing is visibly hand-inked on the paper, while the surrounding stationery stays photorealistic. Make the face and spiky hair large and visually clear, taking up most of the top sheet. Preserve the restrained cream-and-purple palette and clear top corners. Output one finished landscape 4:3 image.
